episode_summary: Valerie Fitzgerald shares her inspiring journey from a struggling single mother to a top luxury real estate agent. She emphasizes the importance of courage, blind faith, and strategic use of AI to build a successful career. Valerie's story provides actionable insights for breaking into the luxury market and leveraging technology to enhance personal branding.
